response.sql: WITH per_store AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM customer WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id) SELECT store_id, active_customers, active_customers / (SELECT SUM(active_customers) FROM per_store) AS share_of_total, active_customers / (SELECT AVG(active_customers) FROM per_store) AS relative_to_average FROM per_store ORDER BY store_id;

assumptions.assumption: The average count per store is the mean of the per-store active counts over stores that have at least one active customer. The store table also lists 2 stores, so the result is the same under that definition.
active = 1 selects active customers, since the BOOLEAN column stores TRUE as 1.
